objective: Test whether deferring corpus token-length aggregation until a query has matching documents improves sparse and no-answer search without changing rankings.

exclude: retaining runtime change without consistent measured benefit

acceptance: Run 31 alternating baseline/candidate measurements on the current repository corpus and deterministic 500-file, 20,000-line corpus.
Require exact ordered result equality for all fixed queries.
Record individual samples, source hashes, corpus fingerprints and corpus sizes.
Retain the prototype only if it improves the target workload without a material regression on the repository corpus.
